intent: Choose a supported language for auto-translation.
actions: Open the Contributor Dashboard Admin page with Translation Admin, Release Coordinator and super-admin access, and automatic translation suggestions enabled for the account through its user group.
Wait for Manage supported languages for auto-translation to load with an empty mapping, no language or provider selected, and the separate automatic-suggestions switch off.
Open the Language chooser and type e.
Press Arrow Down until English is visibly highlighted.
Press Enter to confirm the selection.
